name: Slingshot
description:
This bow gains a sling, a 9-slot item inventory which can hold non-equipment items. Shooting without any arrows instead fires items from the sling, applying unique effects such as:

  • Blocks deal damage based on hardness.
  • Glass shatters, dealing 50% radial damage.
  • Light-emitting blocks make targets glow.
  • Food is fed to the target.
